primary_title: APS, an adaptor protein containing Pleckstrin homology (PH) and Src homology-2 (SH2) domains inhibits the JAK-STAT pathway in collaboration with c-Cbl
decision_basis: Primary phospho-EPOR binding and EPO reconstitution assays support pY343-dependent APS recruitment with bounded CBL-associated inhibitory output.
limitations_preserved: Preserve pY343, APS/SH2B2, CBL and EPO/JAK context; no universal degradation, terminal-TF or SCI inference.
